# Data Engineering Interview

> SQL, data modeling, and pipeline design rounds, with six pipeline design walkthroughs. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Cheat sheets

- [Common Mistakes](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/common-mistakes.md): Twelve errors that candidates make repeatedly in data engineering interviews, grouped by round.
- [Four-Week Plan](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/four-week-plan.md): This plan prepares an engineer who already writes basic SQL for a data engineering loop in four weeks.
- [Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/question-bank.md): Sixty questions, grouped by round.
- [SQL Patterns](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/sql-patterns.md): Ten query shapes answer most SQL questions in a data engineering interview.

## Concepts

- [Batch vs Streaming](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/batch-vs-streaming.md): Batch processing handles a bounded set of data on a schedule, such as all of yesterday's orders at 2:00.
- [Data Quality and Testing](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/data-quality-and-testing.md): Data quality means that a table is correct enough for the decision it supports.
- [Data Warehouse vs Data Lake vs Lakehouse](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/data-warehouse-vs-data-lake-vs-lakehouse.md): A data warehouse is a database built for analytic queries over structured tables.
- [Delivery Guarantees](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/delivery-guarantees.md): A delivery guarantee states how many times a record can affect the output when failures occur.
- [Dimensional Modeling](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/dimensional-modeling.md): Dimensional modeling is a way of shaping tables for analysis.
- [ETL vs ELT](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/etl-vs-elt.md): ETL stands for extract, transform, load: data is reshaped on a separate processing system before it reaches the warehouse.
- [Idempotency and Backfills](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/idempotency-and-backfills.md): A pipeline job is idempotent when running it twice for the same input produces the same output as running it once.
- [Late Data and Watermarks](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/late-data-and-watermarks.md): Late data is an event that reaches the pipeline after the period it belongs to has already been processed.
- [Orchestration](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/orchestration.md): Orchestration is the scheduling and coordination of pipeline jobs: which job runs, when, after which other jobs, and what happens on failure.
- [Partitioning and File Formats](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/partitioning-and-file-formats.md): Two layout decisions control how much data an analytic query must read.
- [Slowly Changing Dimensions](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/slowly-changing-dimensions.md): A slowly changing dimension is a dimension table whose attributes change occasionally, such as a store's region or a customer's plan.
- [Spark Essentials](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/concepts/spark-essentials.md): Apache Spark is a distributed processing engine that splits a dataset into partitions and runs the same code on each partition in parallel.

## Questions

- [Design a Change Data Capture Pipeline](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-change-data-capture-pipeline.md): Change data capture (CDC) is the practice of copying every insert, update, and delete from an operational database to another system, usually a warehouse.
- [Design a Clickstream Pipeline](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-clickstream-pipeline.md): A clickstream pipeline collects the events that users generate in a website or an app, such as page views and taps, and turns them into tables for analysis.
- [Design a Daily Sales Warehouse](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-daily-sales-warehouse.md): This question asks for a warehouse that reports a retailer's sales each morning.
- [Design a Data Quality Monitoring System](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-data-quality-monitoring-system.md): This question asks for a platform that checks hundreds of tables and tells the right team when one is wrong.
- [Design a Log Analytics Platform](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-log-analytics-platform.md): A log analytics platform collects the logs that servers and applications write, stores them, and lets engineers search and aggregate them.
- [Design a Real-Time Fraud Feature Pipeline](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-real-time-fraud-feature-pipeline.md): A fraud model scores each payment before it is approved.

## Rounds

- [The Behavioral Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/rounds/behavioral.md): The behavioral round asks for real events from the candidate's work, told as short stories.
- [The Coding Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/rounds/coding.md): The coding round for a data engineer usually uses Python on data, not abstract algorithm puzzles.
- [The Data Modeling Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/rounds/data-modeling.md): The data modeling round asks the candidate to design tables for analysis, not for an application.
- [The Data Engineering Interview Loop](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/rounds/interview-loop.md): A data engineering loop usually has three stages: a recruiter call, one technical screen, and four or five final rounds.
- [The Pipeline Design Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/rounds/pipeline-design.md): The pipeline design round is the data engineer's system design interview.
- [The SQL Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/data-engineering-interview/blob/main/rounds/sql.md): The SQL round for a data engineer assumes joins and GROUP BY and tests what comes after them.
